name: Light Tone
extraction_method: Dominant RGB pixel in the visually reviewed Light Tone WP1470 chart cell; Poppler 26.05.0 pdftoppm -f 2 -l 2 -scale-to 2200 -png -singlefile; rendered size 2200x1569; half-open pixel box [2006,972,2087,1043]; RGB [176,54,34], 3634 of 5751 pixels.
accuracy: Approximate digital swatch from the 2019 Army Painter catalogue distributed by Freesia Enterprise. The red-brown printed swatch is not a measured dried wash colour; substrate, application and rendering colour management affect appearance. Not a Fanatic or Quickshade Dip equivalent.
